observations.executedBy: Codex QA actual Chrome UI and independent screenshot inspection
observations.title: F63 synthetic Web photos: creation preview, replacement, published list/detail, attribution and fallback
steps: A new isolated OWN database/API/Web used normal random OTP, profile, all four create steps and explicit publish. No source-B or retained user was reused. Google/model/real-mail calls0.

Review displayed actual green A pixels and Synthetic Author A; normal reselect B required reconfirming time/reservation while preserving introduction. Review then displayed actual purple B pixels and author without old A.

Explicit publish produced one synthetic meal; actual detail and hosting list displayed purple B and correct attribution. Author links from review and hosting list opened the exact pinned fixture README in a new tab; original create/list URL remained unchanged, no accidental meal navigation.

Fixed no_photo mode followed by reload showed a neutral placeholder without photo/author in list. Fixed provider-unavailable mode showed placeholder in detail while meal details remained usable. This actual UI observation does not itself establish HTTP503; separate OWN API proof covers503.
Restoring photo mode and reloading displayed purple B again. Screenshots were directly viewed, not inferred from AX image presence or mocked onLoad.

Late A response, native UI, image decode/network failure and placeId mismatch are still unverified. Assets and author labels are synthetic, not Google photos/licensing evidence. F63 remains open and G-PLACES blocked.
observations.classification: partial synthetic-client verification; no whole-case promotion
